title: TitanLogin-plugin
description: This is a modern login/register plugin with advanced features
body:
## 🚀 TitanLogin — Military-Grade Authentication

**Secure • Intelligent • Performance-Optimized**

TitanLogin is a next-generation authentication plugin built for modern Minecraft servers.
It combines **strong encryption, real-time monitoring, and a premium user experience** — without disruptive auto-bans.


---

### 🎮 Commands

`/register` • `/login` • `/logout` • `/security` • `/titanlogin reload` `/titanlogin:resetpass` and other many admin commands 

---

### 🔐 Security Layer

* AES-256 + BCrypt hashing
* IP change detection & session validation
* Alt account monitoring system  etc.

---

### 📡 Intelligence & Alerts

* Real-time staff alerts (sound + actionbar)
* IP & alt detection notifications
* Security logging system
* Lightweight event-driven alerts

---

### 🎨 Player Experience

* RGB gradient messaging
* Animated login progress bar
* Particle & UI effects
* Clean, modern interface

---

### ⚙️ System & Performance

* Async database operations
* 50+ configurable options
* Compatible with any spawn system
* Optimized for high player counts

---

### 📦 Quick Info

* **Version:** 2.0.0
* **Minecraft:** 1.21 – 1.21.11
* **Platform:** Paper / Spigot / Purpur
* **Author:** Iraxeyy

---

### 🔑 Permissions

* `titanlogin.staff` — receive alerts
* `titanlogin.admin` — full control

---

> **No false bans. Just intelligence.**
